T: Eight days left. Make every meal count.
D: Days from retirement, Murtaugh gets pulled into one last case with Riggs and Lorna.
P: Pour drinks during the retirement countdown.
S: Griddled franks in steamed buns with yellow mustard
Franks simmered then griddled, in steamed buns with yellow mustard, sweet relish and chopped onion.
Leo's open home smoked trout and quiches

Cucumber rounds topped with whipped cream cheese, smoked trout and dill, alongside warm bacon and leek mini quiches, like a real estate open house. Heat the oven to 180C. Press 12 shortcrust rounds into a mini muffin tray. Fry 2 diced bacon rashers with 1 sliced leek until soft and divide between the cases. Whisk 2 eggs with 100ml cream and 40g grated gruyère, pour in and bake 18 minutes. Beat 150g cream cheese with lemon zest, pipe onto 16 thick cucumber rounds and top with flaked smoked trout and dill.
Popcorn tossed in melted butter, garlic powder and grated parmesan
Popcorn tossed with melted butter, garlic powder and finely grated parmesan, piled high in a bowl.
M: Chicken thighs simmered in stock with vegetables and self-raising dumplings
Chicken thighs simmered with onion, celery, carrot and thyme, shredded back into a creamy broth, fluffy dumplings (self-raising flour, butter, milk) spooned on top and steamed 15 minutes.
Scar comparison sticky beef short ribs
Riggs and Lorna compare scars, you compare sauce

Beef short ribs slow-roasted until they pull from the bone, glazed with a sticky cola barbecue sauce, with buttered corn. Heat the oven to 160°C. Rub the ribs with the sugar, paprika and salt and put in a deep tray with the stock. Cover tightly with foil and roast until tender. Simmer the cola and barbecue sauce until syrupy, brush over the ribs and roast uncovered until sticky. Boil the corn and serve with butter alongside the ribs.
W: Lemon zest butter cake soaked in lemon syrup
Lemon drizzle loaf: butter, sugar, eggs, flour and lemon zest baked at 170C for 50 minutes, soaked with lemon juice and sugar while hot.
K: Eight days to go whiskey sour
Bourbon, lemon and sugar syrup shaken with egg white until foamy

Bourbon shaken hard with lemon, sugar syrup and egg white until frothy, poured over ice with a dash of bitters and a cocktail cherry. Add 240ml bourbon, 120ml fresh lemon juice, 80ml sugar syrup and 2 egg whites to a shaker without ice and shake hard for 15 seconds to foam. Add a big handful of ice and shake again for 10 seconds. Strain into 4 tumblers over fresh ice. Shake 2 dashes of aromatic bitters onto the foam of each and add a cocktail cherry.

s.note: Griddled franks in steamed buns with yellow mustard
s.how: Simmer 8 franks in water for 5 minutes, then griddle until blistered all over. Steam 8 hot dog buns until soft. Fill with franks and top with yellow mustard, sweet relish and a spoon of finely chopped onion.

s.note: Popcorn tossed in melted butter, garlic powder and grated parmesan
s.how: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a big pot with 3 kernels. When they pop, add 120g kernels, cover and shake until popping slows. Toss with 50g melted butter, 1 tsp garlic powder and 40g finely grated parmesan while still hot.

m.note: Chicken thighs simmered in stock with vegetables and self-raising dumplings
m.how: Simmer 800g chicken thighs with 1 onion, 2 celery sticks, 2 carrots, thyme and 1.5L stock for 40 minutes. Shred the chicken back in. Mix 200g self-raising flour, 50g butter and 150ml milk, drop spoonfuls on top and steam covered for 15 minutes.

w.note: Lemon zest butter cake soaked in lemon syrup
w.how: Beat 175g butter with 175g sugar, add 3 eggs, then fold in 175g self-raising flour and the zest of 2 lemons. Bake at 170C for 50 minutes. Mix the juice of 2 lemons with 100g sugar and pour over the hot loaf.

d.how: Add 240ml bourbon, 120ml fresh lemon juice, 80ml sugar syrup and 2 egg whites to a shaker without ice and shake hard for 15 seconds to foam. Add a big handful of ice and shake again for 10 seconds. Strain into 4 tumblers over fresh ice. Shake 2 dashes of aromatic bitters onto the foam of each and add a cocktail cherry.
